findings.evidence: Intertwining.lean:170-180 proves `(DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out ∈ H` by unpacking `(DoubleCoset.eq H H (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out 1).mp (DoubleCoset.out_eq' ...)` and computing `a⁻¹ * b⁻¹`; Identity.lean:32-41 proves `DoubleCoset.mk H H s = DoubleCoset.mk H H 1 ↔ s ∈ H` by the same unpacking. `DoubleCoset.out_eq' H H (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1) : DoubleCoset.mk H H (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out = DoubleCoset.mk H H 1` (Mathlib/GroupTheory/DoubleCoset.lean, `out_eq'`) is exactly the iff's left side. `grep -rn out_mem_of_doubleCoset_mk_one TauCeti/` shows only the definition (:170) and one use (:204).
findings.fix: Add `public import TauCeti.GroupTheory.DoubleCoset.Identity` to `Intertwining.lean` (Identity.lean imports only `Mathlib.GroupTheory.DoubleCoset`, so no cycle) and replace the proof body with the one-liner `(doubleCosetMk_eq_mk_one_iff H _).mp (DoubleCoset.out_eq' H H _)`, deleting the `obtain`/`calc` block. Its single use at Intertwining.lean:204 is unaffected.
findings.issue: `out_mem_of_doubleCoset_mk_one (H) : (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out ∈ H` is the instance `s := (DoubleCoset.mk H H 1).out` of the new `TauCeti.doubleCosetMk_eq_mk_one_iff` (TauCeti/GroupTheory/DoubleCoset/Identity.lean:32), but it retains its own ten-line derivation (`hout : ... = a⁻¹ * b⁻¹` from `DoubleCoset.eq` + `DoubleCoset.out_eq'`) — the identical argument the new lemma proves generically. The PR therefore ships the same fact twice, proved twice.

summary: The new `doubleCosetMk_eq_mk_one_iff` subsumes the existing `out_mem_of_doubleCoset_mk_one` in the same PR's `Intertwining.lean`, whose ten-line hand proof is now a redundant re-derivation. Everything else in the PR reuses located Mathlib and TauCeti API (`Action.resEquiv`, `Functor.FullyFaithful.homEquiv`, `Linear.homCongr`, `mackeySubgroupCongr`, `Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe`) and adds genuinely new material.
